mostWorthwhile.text: Checking the address against the handset was most worthwhile: it established that the problem was the service directory, not a typo, and gave the story stakes beyond moving a crate.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the replacement caster was straightforward and satisfying, but as the only offered combination it involved little decision-making.

surprise.text: The handset read the address correctly but rejected it because the clinic was absent from the active directory; the impending migration made that exclusion more consequential.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The repair and delivery steps had clear practical purposes, even when only one action was offered.

continue.text: Yes. The conflict between the signed receipt and the rejection makes me curious how the neighborhood will challenge the directory, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
